basic_details.job_title: VRDE Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 15 Paid Internship Posts
basic_details.short_information: Vehicles Research & Development Establishment (VRDE), under the Defence Research & Development Organisation (DRDO), Ministry of Defence, Ahilyanagar, Maharashtra, has invited students going to the final year of B.E/B.Tech in the academic year 2026-2027 for paid internships of six months, starting 1 January 2027 tentatively, with a total stipend of Rs. 30,000 paid in two instalments. There are 15 indicative vacancies in four disciplines. The duly filled application with enclosures goes by post to the Director, VRDE, and a scanned copy of the documents goes by mail; applications received after t

how_to_apply: Fill in the "Format for Application for Paid Internship Scheme" printed in the notice (page 3). It asks for name, date of birth, Aadhar number, college name, address and contact number, discipline, branch code, degree and semester, CGPA, languages known, permanent and local address, contact numbers and email ID.
Affix a passport size photograph (4.5x3.5 cm) on the form, tick the checklist and sign the declaration with place and date.
Get the referral letter printed on college letterhead and signed by the Principal / Director of the college or institution, with office seal. The notice marks the referral letter as mandatory.
Enclose the referral letter, a copy of the CGPA and a copy of the latest Aadhar Card.

Send the duly filled application with enclosures to: The Director, Defence Research & Development Organisation, Vehicles Research & Development Establishment, Vahannagar PO, Ahilyanagar – 414006 (Maharashtra).
Write "Application for Paid Internship with Discipline" on the envelope, along with the discipline applied for.
Send a scanned copy of the student documents along with the application form by mail to [email protected].

Applications received after the due date will not be considered, and no further communication in this regard will be entertained. For other queries, contact 0241-2544004 Ext-4280 (Ms. Sunita Kumari, TO 'A') on working days, Monday to Friday, 09:00 to 17:00 hrs.
Request for a paid internship of six months for the student, from 1 January 2027 to 30 June 2027, addressed to the Director, VRDE.
Student details: name, course, permanent registration number / college ID number, mobile number, permanent residential address and email ID.
Faculty coordinator details: name, designation, department, contact number, email ID and HOD email ID.
College details: name, AICTE Permanent ID, DTE Code, affiliated to, affiliated ID, email ID, contact number and fax number.

A statement that the college has no objection to the internship, that the student will be physically present in the establishment for a minimum of 15 working days in a month and will be relieved, that the college will give the indemnity form as and when required by VRDE, and that the student will complete the full tenure.
important_instructions: After selection, the candidate must obtain a Police Verification Certificate and submit it at the time of joining; the acknowledgement received from the local Police Station is to be submitted at joining. At joining, selected students must submit the original No Objection Certificate (NOC) from the college authorities on college letterhead, stating that the student will be relieved for the internship at VRDE and will be present for a minimum of 15 working days in a month. Selected students need to provide bank details for transfer of the internship amount. At joining, the student must bring the original Aadhar Card along with the college ID card, and submit 02 passport size photographs. All previous semesters' marks sheets must be brought in original for verification. Original documents will be returned immediately after verification. Any other documents, if required, will be communicated at the time of selection / joining. If any information is found concealed or distorted, the internship is liable to be summarily terminated without prior notice, as per the applicant's declaration. Completion of the internship does not guarantee employment in DRDO.

content_sections.heading: About VRDE
content_sections.text: VRDE, under the aegis of DRDO, is engaged in research and development in the area of Light Tracked and Wheeled Vehicles. According to the notice, it is also committed to designing and developing indigenous solutions in Mobility Systems, Wheeled & Light Tracked Combat Systems, and Wheeled Launched Systems for Strategic & Tactical Programmes. Its address is Vahannagar PO, Ahilyanagar – 414006 (Maharashtra).

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: VRDE is offering 15 internships in total. The notice says the numbers are indicative and may increase or decrease at the absolute discretion of the Establishment. The notice gives no category-wise break-up of these vacancies.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The same eligibility applies to all four disciplines. Students who are going to the final year of B.E/B.Tech in the academic year 2026-2027 can apply for the paid internship. Students with backlogs are not eligible. The application format asks for the degree as UG (B.E) or UG (B.Tech) with the semester (7th/8th), the discipline, the branch code and the CGPA on a scale of 10. The college referral letter is for a VII/VIII semester engineering student. The notice gives no desirable qualification and no experience requirement. For the discipline-specific eligibility of each post, refer to the official notification.

rows.discipline: Electronics & Communication Engineering; Computer Science Engineering; Electrical Engineering; Mechanical Engineering
rows.essential_qualification: Student going to the final year B.E/B.Tech in the academic year 2026-2027, with no backlogs

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The paid internship is fixed for six months starting 1 January 2027 tentatively. The referral letter format mentions the period 1 January 2027 to 30 June 2027. The stipend is Rs. 30,000/- in total, paid in two instalments: Rs. 15,000/- after completion of 3 months and Rs. 15,000/- after completion of 6 months. The stipend is subject to attendance of a minimum of 45 days in three months. Lodging, boarding, transport, medical and other expenditure, if any, will not be borne by VRDE during the internship. No payment will be made to students who do not fulfil the required tenure of three months. Students who do not complete the 6 months will not be awarded the Internship Certificate; the Certificate of Completion is awarded on successful completion, which includes clearing the evaluation of project work and submitting the project report and completing other formalities. If a student leaves in between, VRDE / DRDO will not issue a Certificate of Completion.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selection will be based entirely on merit basis. Selected students will be informed by email along with the terms & conditions and guidelines of the internship; the tentative date for this is 20 December 2026. No communication will be undertaken for rejected candidates. The management reserves the right to change the vacancy position or selection criteria at any point during the selection process without assigning any reason. The notice does not describe any other selection stage.

faq.question: Q1. How many internship vacancies are there in VRDE Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 15 indicative vacancies: 03 in Electronics & Communication Engineering, 02 in Computer Science Engineering, 05 in Electrical Engineering and 05 in Mechanical Engineering. The numbers may increase or decrease.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the VRDE paid internship?
faq.answer: The last date for application is 12 December 2026. Applications received after the due date will not be considered.

faq.question: Q3. Who is eligible for the VRDE paid internship?
faq.answer: Students who are going to the final year of B.E/B.Tech in the academic year 2026-2027 can apply. Students with backlogs are not eligible.

faq.question: Q4. What is the stipend for the VRDE internship?
faq.answer: The stipend is Rs. 30,000/- in total for the six months, paid as Rs. 15,000/- after 3 months and Rs. 15,000/- after 6 months, subject to attendance of a minimum of 45 days in three months.

faq.question: Q5. How do I apply for the VRDE internship?
faq.answer: Send the duly filled application with enclosures to The Director, VRDE, Vahannagar PO, Ahilyanagar – 414006 (Maharashtra), with "Application for Paid Internship with Discipline" written on the envelope. Also mail a scanned copy of the documents to [email protected].

faq.question: Q6. How are students selected for the VRDE internship?
faq.answer: Selection will be based entirely on merit basis. Selected students are informed by email, tentatively on 20 December 2026.

faq.question: Q7. When does the VRDE internship start and how long is it?
faq.answer: The internship is for six months, starting from 1 January 2027 tentatively.

faq.question: Q8. Does the VRDE internship guarantee a job in DRDO?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that completion of the internship does not guarantee employment in DRDO.

faq.question: Q9. Will VRDE pay for accommodation or travel during the internship?
faq.answer: No. Lodging, boarding, transport, medical and other expenditure, if any, will not be borne by VRDE during the paid internship.

faq.question: Q10. What documents must selected students bring at joining?
faq.answer: Selected students must bring the original NOC on college letterhead, the Police station acknowledgement for police verification, bank details, the original Aadhar Card with college ID card, 02 passport size photographs and all previous semesters' marks sheets in original.
